_comment: Read by tools/req_ids.py (US-19-R19). Files whose requirement ids are fixture specifications written inside a test, not citations of the real specifications. Each entry gives the reason; the ids of a listed file are still reported when --no-fixtures is passed.

files.core/conformance/conformance.test.js: defines the fixture specifications 90 and 91 inline to test the conformance parser
files.core/conformance/attest.test.js: defines the fixture specification 90 inline to test attestation
files.core/conformance/scan-python.test.js: defines the fixture specification 90 inline to test the Python and seed test scan
files.core/conformance/running.test.js: cites a fixture id inside a fixture specification for the RUNNING-label checker
